snippet.title: Legendary Pilots - Now Available on Steam
snippet.description:
Legendary Pilots is out now on Steam.

Take off, build your reputation, and chart your own path through a charming retro-styled aviation world. Start with humble routes and work your way up — fly turbo-props and regional jets, manage your fleet, compete in a living airline economy, and shape your own legacy in the skies.

Every decision counts. Every flight matters.

✈ Play now → https://store.steampowered.com/app/2393730/Legendary_Pilots/

#LegendaryPilots #FlightSim #IndieGame #SteamRelease
